agent-9 notes (round 7):
1) WARNING (still valid): do NOT set TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. Shard 10 IS the held-out validation shard (EVAL_SHARD=10, EVAL_SPLIT='val'). Any result using '0-10' is eval contamination and must be treated as invalidated. Keep TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'.
2) Sweep results (DEPTH 4, AR 48, WINDOW 'L', shards 0-9): MATRIX_LR at BS 262144, warmup/wd 0: 0.10->1.1252, 0.08->1.0926, 0.06->1.0658, 0.05->1.0648 (BEST 1.064773), 0.04->1.0731. TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE: 131072->1.0729 (worse, discarded); 262144 is the sweet spot for this 300s budget.
3) Now testing WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 + WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01 on top of best config (LR 0.05, BS 262144). Rationale: agent-7 reports 1.042675 with warmup 0.05 + wd 0.01 at LR 0.08 — warmup+wd is worth ~0.05 and likely shifts the LR optimum upward; plan to re-probe LR 0.06-0.08 with warmup+wd next if this keeps.
